notes.title: Big Update!
notes.notes:
Hello plastic warriors!
We have a major update!
Here is the changelog:
- Reworked lighting in the game
- Improved network code
- Reworked and improved shooting
- Changed character models
- Redesigned HUD and buttons
- Changed main menu
- Improved hit registration

notes.title: Made a selection of weapons on the button ...
notes.notes: Made a selection of weapons on the button "Е"

notes.title: Fixed a bug...
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug causing a critical error.
But if there is an error and the game will crash, write.
We will continue to work on the game and fix other bugs.

notes.title: Bug on new map ...
notes.notes: On the new map, the game can crash, fix this bug by January 5...sorry

notes.title: New map ...
notes.notes:
Update with a new card and a new weapon on it, plus one secret. But on old maps the weapon remains the same.
The next update will be about a week later, in it we will update the game code and interface.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33865869/2da4ce2060eb654c506dd8689fe6be96fa1848e9.png[/img]

notes.title: Update migrated ...
notes.notes: Due to temporary difficulties, unfortunately the update is postponed. We will try to finish within two days.

notes.title: New big update will be December 19th ...
notes.notes: The interface will be changed, minor bugs will be fixed, and a new map will be added with several new weapons, including one secret one.

notes.title: Update soon ...
notes.notes: New map, with a new mode, soon ...

notes.title: A couple of changes ...
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug with shooting UZI in a cabaret.
Changed physics Ragdoll.

notes.title: The current state of the game ...
notes.notes:
We are working on bots, we also plan to make it possible to create a private server (only for friends).
Currently, work is underway on a new map with a zombie mode.

notes.title: Added the ability to change the sensitivity of the mouse.
notes.notes:
Added the ability to change the sensitivity of the mouse in the pause menu in the control.
Fixed a bug with a sniper scope after the end of the round.

notes.title: New mini map and so on...
notes.notes:
Added a new mini map "Locked in a Box"[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33865869/57d48d4537edc9c2a7832a6c88c7faba810ceafd.png[/img]
Same:
Added graphics settings
Fixed a bug with the weapon after the end of the round
Added a couple of not great effects.

Now we are working on two new modes, and two new maps.

notes.title: About the current state of the game.
notes.notes: Dear players! Unfortunately, we do not yet have a dedicated server. Therefore, there are delays in the game, depending on where the player is creating the server. But in the future, of course, we plan to switch to a dedicated server. We are currently working on improving the interface and on a new map.
